children: Thailand’s business confidence indicator fell to 48.1 in September 2026 from 49.8 in the previous month, remaining below the 50 threshold for the ninth straight month.
Sentiment weakened across performance (50.2 vs 53 in August), production (51.5 vs 54.5), and employment (50.3 vs 51.6).
By sector, confidence in manufacturing declined, led by agricultural product manufacturers amid El Niño-induced drought conditions.

The non-manufacturing index remained below the 50 threshold for the tenth consecutive month, particularly in transportation, which was affected by higher diesel prices following renewed Middle East tensions, as well as retail trade, due to lower orders for consumer goods and fading effects of government measures.
Lastly, sentiment in the automotive industry weakened, particularly among auto parts manufacturers, as rising EV imports reduced demand for domestically produced parts.
The three-month expected Business Sentiment Index edged up to 50.8 from 50.5 in August.

title: Thailand Business Confidence Remains Subdued
